summary: Verified new share-whatsapp and share-email buttons on DocumentDetail header alongside existing copy-doc-link and print-document. All 4 buttons render, visible, enabled. WhatsApp click triggers window.open with correct https://wa.me/?text=... URL containing document id. Email button clickable with no console error (mailto navigation cannot be captured due to browser location.href being non-redefinable, which is expected/acceptable). No console errors on the detail view. Regression: header layout intact, all 4 buttons on one row.
context_for_next_testing_agent: DocumentDetail header now has share-whatsapp (window.open to wa.me), share-email (mailto via location.href), copy-doc-link, print-document. wa.me URL verified to contain doc id and shareText format 'PPBJ 001/PPBJ-BJM/09/2026 — Uji tombol bagikan\nLihat dokumen: {origin}/documents/{id}'. Mailto capture in headless is not feasible because location.href is not redefinable; only click no-error was verified. Toast for copy-link may not appear in headless due to clipboard permission but was verified in iteration_11.
